newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-SWEDEN KEEP THYLANDER FOR BELARUS QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDEN KEEP THYLANDER FOR BELARUS QUALIFIER.

text.p: Malmo defender Mattias Thylander has been named in Sweden's squad for a World Cup qualifying match in Belarus on August 20.
Thylander made his debut in a friendly in Lithuania last month and joins an established group of players in the 20-man squad.
Sweden are currently third in European group four, a point behind Austria and five behind leaders Scotland. They have two games in hand over Scotland.
Goalkeepers: Magnus Hedman (Coventry), Thomas Ravelli (IFK Gothenburg)

Defenders: Patrik Andersson (Borussia Moenchengladbach), Joachim Bjorklund (Glasgow Rangers), Andreas Jacobsson (Helsingborg), Pontus Kamark (Leicester), Jozo Matovac (Orgryte), Gary Sundgren (Real Zaragoza), Mattias Thylander (Malmo)
Midfielders: Niclas Alexandersson (IFK Gothenburg), Anders Andersson (Blackburn), Jesper Blomqvist (AC Milan), Hakan Mild (Real Sociedad), Jonas Thern (Glasgow Rangers), Per Zetterberg (Anderlecht)
Forwards: Andreas Andersson (AC Milan), Kennet Andersson (Bologna), Martin Dahlin (Blackburn), Mattias Jonsson (Helsingborg), Jorgen Pettersson (Borussia Moenchengladbach).
